texts.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
texts.en:
By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the [this.GetName] has been fulfilled.

texts.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的抟土之塑师面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
texts.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of the Animator of Clay.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.

While not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.

No longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.

label.en: We are but leaves on the wind.

texts.zh:
位面之外客哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！

我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
texts.en:
The mournful essence of the Outsider seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

Some things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!

We know of this one. We have encountered this Zroni, the 'Far-Seer', before. How it came to be here is unclear, but we would be wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

Some things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!

This entity remains a mystery to us. We understand little of its ominous warning.

texts.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着黄金之幻梦安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在黄金之幻梦的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
texts.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the Golden Dream.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with the Golden Dream. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

label.zh: 我们一边玩一边逃到有意义的地方去。
label.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.

texts.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了无尽之潮汐粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
texts.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the Endless Tide.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

texts.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是苍茫之层峦。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
texts.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the Pale Mountain itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

label.zh: 我们思想的一次伟大重生。
label.en: A grand rebirth of our minds.

texts.zh:
空洞之点尖的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

空洞之点尖的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
texts.en:
The serenity of the Hollow Point fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of the Hollow Point is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

texts.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是空置之御座。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
texts.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the Vacant Throne.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

texts.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是幽黑之长河出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
texts.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the Black River.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

label.zh: 我们见到了宇宙的边缘吗？
label.en: Have we seen the edge of the universe?

texts.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从虚境里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
texts.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the Shroud.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

label.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
label.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

texts.zh:
在一个虚境的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
texts.en:
In a fold of the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

texts.zh:
我们知道许多虚境中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——繁多的嘈杂渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
这个被称为悲伤之物的遥远的力量从虚境深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：

在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……
texts.en:
The distant power known as Sorrowed Entity seared our minds with anguish from deep within the Shroud. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

Tread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...

texts.zh: 我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在星界裂隙那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的位面之外客吗？
texts.en: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an Astral Rift. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now the Outsider?

texts.zh:
这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？

不管这意味着什么，位面之外客已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
texts.en:
This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?

Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

texts.zh: 不管这意味着什么，位面之外客已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
texts.en: Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

label.zh: 我们可别屈从相同的命运。
label.en: Let us not succumb to the same fate.

texts.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是轮回之终末，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：“时机未到。”缓了一下后。“但并非不可。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

只要我们能带向终末。
texts.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

label.zh: 和轮回之终末签订契约
label.en: Form a Covenant with the End of the Cycle
Exit the Shroud and try to forget.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与轮回之终末签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：“时日已到。”

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经虚境的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: "THE END BEGINS."

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

We were left to estimate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

label.zh: 愿神灵对我们怀有仁慈。
label.en: May the spirits have mercy on us all.

label.zh: 机械智能 · 唯心主义
机械智能 · 格式塔意识
蜂巢思维 · 唯心主义
蜂巢思维 · 格式塔意识

texts.zh:
我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。

问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻魂灵之月窠的启示？
texts.en:
Our communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of the Cradle of Souls?

label.zh: 我们听到了魂灵之月窠的。你为什么这么问？
label.en: We have heard the Cradle of Souls. Why do you ask?

label.zh: 你想要从我们这里得到什么？
label.en: What do you want from us?

texts.zh:
战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于世界之喰煞。你也一样。
texts.en:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. As do you.

texts.zh:
战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于世界之喰煞。或许你也会这样。
texts.en:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. Perhaps you will too.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

label.zh: 为什么你要侍奉世界之喰煞？
label.en: Why do you serve the Eater of Worlds?

texts.zh:
莫尔的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。

你也感受到了，对吧？渴求之器具永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
texts.en:
Morr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.

You feel it too, don't you? The Instrument of Desire is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

label.zh: 为什么你要侍奉渴求之器具？
label.en: Why do you serve the Instrument of Desire?

texts.zh:
当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同生命之织缕的低鸣。

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日生命之织缕为我编织了何等形态？

通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。

你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是受苦者克罗南，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。
texts.en:
As our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of the Composer of Strands.

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has the Composer of Strands spun for me today?

The comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still Kronen the Afflicted. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

label.en: Why do you want to join us?

texts.zh:
通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？虚空之低语的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
texts.en:
The communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of the Whisperers in the Void, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

label.zh: 为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？
label.en: What makes you think you can help?

label.zh: 你对于低语之主有何了解？
label.en: What do you know of the Whisperers?

texts.zh:
我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
texts.en:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

texts.zh: 我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。
texts.en: It is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.

texts.zh: 这时我们才注意到，此人的眼窝空空如也，早已被摈弃。
texts.en: It is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.

texts.zh: 得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见轮回之终末那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。
texts.en: Come now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of the End of the Cycle. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

label.zh: 你知晓轮回之终末的存在有多久了？
label.en: How long have you known of the End of the Cycle?

label.zh: 你为什么想要帮助我们？
label.en: Why do you want to help us?

texts.zh:
凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，奥伏戎便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入虚境之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
texts.en:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为悲伤之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sorrowed Entity.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集专职的灵能使子个体，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为悲伤之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of dedicated telepath drones, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sorrowed Entity.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为悲伤之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sorrowed Entity.

texts.zh:
虚境中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
texts.en:
The entities within the Shroud are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.
